name: Demarchy
author: karamble
description: Decred staking, node and Bison Relay status in the bar

barWidget.description: Your staking record, ticket price and unread Bison Relay messages

schema.label: Monitor dcrpulse
schema.description: Off means the widget opens no connection at all; the bar shows the greyed mark alone and the panel keeps the last snapshot.

schema.label: Private messages light the bar
schema.description: Incoming PMs raise the unread count and colour the bar mark.

schema.label: Group chats light the bar
schema.description: Group messages raise the unread count too. A busy group can keep the mark permanently lit; turn this off to let private messages stand out.

schema.label: Show wallet balances
schema.description: Off hides the balance rows entirely. On, they are masked until you reveal them, and re-mask when the panel closes.

schema.label: Active connection
schema.description: Which stored dcrpulse connection the panel shows. Set by the switcher in the panel footer; connections themselves live in ~/.config/demarchy/connections.json.
